controls.launch_requirement: Re-check backup freshness, timer health, SQLite integrity and isolated restore immediately before production cutover.
Keep one-time approval consumption and replay rejection enabled.
No provider/system bypass and no live side effect outside an explicitly authorized boundary.
Use an approved least-privilege integration identity, approved secret store, HTTPS-only transport, rotation/revocation procedure and explicit CEO activation gate.
No production credential may be committed, logged, copied into fixtures or exposed to unnecessary surfaces.
Every production activation step requires an owner, abort trigger, verification check and reversible fallback before execution.
Any unresolved critical blocker prevents launch or the affected activation step.

launch_blockers.resolution: Fresh backup, healthy monitor/timer, SQLite quick_check and isolated restore verification must pass.
Approve least-privilege identity, secret storage, rotation and revocation before credentials are introduced.
Obtain explicit CEO approval before live writes, specialist enablement, new execution classes, higher autonomy or Mission Control mutation authority.
Define and verify a reversible cutover/rollback path for the affected production change.
Replay, duplicate and idempotency tests must remain GREEN.
Remove credential material or unauthorized authority before proceeding.
